title: Vibe Coding and Web Application Security: A Twin-Prompt Study
abstract: arXiv:2608.20963v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models increasingly generate complete web applications from natural-language prompts, raising the question of whether explicitly requesting security best practice improves the result. We study six functionally distinct web applications, each generated in two prompt variants that are identical except for an appended security-requirements section: a baseline (A) and a security-aware (B) variant. All twelve programs were produced by the same agentic coding assistant and the same model version in a single, non-iterative generation round, and were then analyzed with static, dependency, dynamic and manual techniques, yielding 75 confirmed findings out of 85 candidates. The security-aware variant produced fewer confirmed findings in every application (24 versus 51) and contained no Critical or High issues; the most severe finding was detected only by manual testing. translated_title: 氛围编程与Web应用安全：一项双提示研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20963v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型越来越多地根据自然语言提示生成完整的Web应用程序，这引发了一个问题，即明确要求安全最佳实践是否能改善结果。我们研究了六个功能不同的Web应用程序，每个程序以两种提示变体生成，除了附加的安全需求部分外完全相同：基线（A）和安全感知（B）变体。所有十二个程序均由相同的代理编码助手和相同的模型版本在单轮非迭代生成中产生，随后通过静态、依赖、动态和手动技术进行分析，从85个候选中确认了75个发现。安全感知变体在每个应用程序中产生的确认发现较少（24对51），且不包含严重或高风险问题；最严重的问题仅通过手动测试检测到。由于语料库较小且每个变体仅生成一次...
tldr: 该研究表明，在提示中明确加入安全需求可以显著减少Web应用生成中的安全漏洞，尽管最严重的问题仍需手动测试才能发现。
en_tdlr: This study shows that explicitly including security requirements in prompts significantly reduces security vulnerabilities in generated web applications, although the most severe issues still require manual testing for detection.
